answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must link a unique hardware signature to their identity. Second, they must deposit a $5,000 bond into the escrow. Third, every vertex in the network validates this hardware proof. This system cannot harbor fake identities because any mismatch will echo through the ledger, triggering an immediate slash. An attacker faces a cost of $50,000 in bonds for just ten identities and 72 hours of setup. It is like requiring a unique, expensive fingerprint to enter a vault where every single door checks your skin.
